'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Sunday 30th May''', 20:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}. 
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. Streamed by [https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1040458874 SuddendeathTV] on Twitch.

== Format ==
* Max 32 player Single-elimination bracket
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 
== Rules ==
* Map order: pick pick toss toss
* Highest seed pick first; all players will be seeded.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
